name: Gaokao Lian'ai Yibai Tian
source:
GaoKao.Love.100Days is a little different to most other romance visual novels in how it starts. You start the story by confessing your love to the adorable Muxin, who soon becomes your girlfriend. In most visual novels this would be the ending.

Of course, not everything is perfect from now on. You have 100 days remaining before the GaoKao – the National College Entrance Exam. This is an extremely competitive exam which will determine the rest of your life. Do you really have time for dating now?

Unlike many visual novels, this story is set in a Chinese high school. While not obvious from first glance, this is a Chinese-made visual novel, rather than the more frequent Japanese type.

This story can go in a few main routes, which splinter off into more than 15 directions, which then turn into more than 50 endings. The amount of endings is a little misleading as the majority of routes have three variations of an ending, but it is still an incredibly high amount.

translation:
《高考.爱情.100天》与大多数其他言情视觉小说的开头方式略有不同。故事开始时，你向可爱的木心表白了你的爱，木心很快就成为了你的女朋友。在大多数视觉小说中，这就是结局。

当然，从现在开始，并不是一切都是完美的。距离高考（全国高考）还有100天。这是一场竞争极其激烈的考试，它将决定你的余生。你现在真的有时间约会吗？

与许多视觉小说不同，这个故事发生在中国的一所高中。虽然乍一看并不明显，但这是一部中国制作的视觉小说，而不是更常见的日本类型。

这个故事可以分为几条主要路线，这些路线又分成超过15个方向，然后变成超过50个结局。结局的数量有点误导，因为大多数路线都有三种结局变化，但它仍然是一个令人难以置信的高数量。
